title: Master / platform protocols
source_note: FDA Master Protocols guidance (final, 2022, oncology focus) and platform trial literature

items.title: Structure and governance
items.requirement: Master protocol structure (umbrella / basket / platform), sub-studies and governance are described.
items.query: master protocol umbrella basket platform structure

items.title: Adding and dropping arms
items.requirement: Rules and procedures for adding new arms and dropping arms (futility/efficacy) are pre-specified.
items.query: adding new arms dropping arms futility platform

items.title: Shared and non-concurrent controls
items.requirement: Use of a shared control arm is described; any use of non-concurrent controls is justified with bias safeguards.

items.title: Randomisation and allocation
items.requirement: Randomisation and any allocation-ratio changes as arms enter or leave are specified.

items.title: Error control per comparison
items.requirement: Type I error control for each sub-study/comparison (and any multiplicity across arms) is stated.
items.query: type I error control each substudy multiplicity arms

items.title: Statistical analysis plan per sub-study
items.requirement: Each sub-study has its own SAP or SAP section, including sample size.
items.query: statistical analysis plan each substudy sample size

items.title: Independent monitoring
items.requirement: An independent DMC and interim analysis plans cover all sub-studies.
items.query: independent data monitoring committee interim analyses master protocol

items.title: Simulation of operating characteristics
items.requirement: Operating characteristics of the platform design are evaluated by simulation.
